stem: When the speed of a car is u, the minimum distance over which it can be stopped is s. If the speed becomes nu, what will be the minimum distance over which it can be stopped? (assuming the braking or retardation is constant)

assets.alt: Velocity–time graph with two parallel lines of slope −a. The smaller triangle starts at u and ends at u/a, with area s; the larger starts at nu and ends at nu/a, with area n²s. A note says same slope −a: similar triangles.
